statement_blocker: The catalog names only the maximal ideal space of H-infinity. It does not define the algebra or space, topology, evaluation map, domain, ordered binders, hypotheses, or any density, equality, Bezout, classification, or other conclusion. A separate target, THM-M-0373, owns a Corona-theorem gloss and selected the finite-generator Bezout formulation. Choosing or inheriting either reading here would invent or substitute mathematics before duplicate reconciliation and primary-source review.
